validation_scope: offline logic, static inspection and automated tests; no powered encoder stream

GUI_SINGLE_SLIDER_SET.evidence: One J1-J6 target slider set edits q_plan_target only.

PLANNED_MUJOCO_VIEW.evidence: The planned view consumes exact integer-grid samples from the same immutable trajectory recipe dispatched to hardware.

ACTUAL_DIGITAL_TWIN_VIEW.evidence: The actual view consumes q_actual only and cannot be driven by target slider changes.

INDEPENDENT_MJDATA.evidence: Planned and actual preview instances each allocate their own MjModel/MjData; neither renderer shares control or collision MjData.

VIRTUAL_PREVIEW_BEFORE_REAL.evidence: Each exact segmented trajectory must receive non-authorizing plan-preview proofs before an execution token can be issued.

REAL_SUBMISSION_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_CLICK.evidence: Only the explicit real-submit action can consume a valid PLAN_TOKEN and request execution.

PLAN_TOKEN_INVALIDATION.evidence: Target, actual-pose drift, session, limits, model, gravity configuration and thermal feasibility changes invalidate authorization.

TEMPERATURE_TABLE.evidence: Seven physical-motor rows preserve J2A/J2B separation and unit-qualified torque fields.

TEMPERATURE_COLOR_STATES.evidence: Offline, normal, warning, rising, derating, stop, cooling and confirmation states include both text and color.

RESTORE_INITIAL_PREVIEW.evidence: Restore initialization follows preview and authority validation before real submission.

QT_MAIN_THREAD_NONBLOCKING.evidence: Exact trajectory generation and planned-request serialization run in a latest-generation single worker; Qt only validates and publishes the fresh serialized result. Each MuJoCo preview creates, renders and closes its OpenGL context on one dedicated background executor; requests coalesce to the latest pending frame while periodic UI updates remain timer driven.

BOTH_RENDERERS_CLOSED.evidence: Window shutdown explicitly closes both planned and actual renderer instances on their owning worker threads.
